units.source_text: 正门旁边，植有一株老菩提树，庄严的繁枝茂叶，在阳光的照耀下呈现出青铜色。

en.t: Beside the main gate stood an old bodhi tree, its solemn, luxuriant branches and leaves taking on a bronze color in the sunlight.

units.source_text: 校舍从主楼起，不断扩建，毫无规则地联在一起，不过，大多是陈旧的木质结构平房。

en.t: Starting from the main building, the school buildings had been continually expanded and joined together without any order, though most of them were old wooden one-story structures.

units.source_text: 这所学校是禁止穿鞋进屋的，一栋房与一栋房之间是由刚破损的竹苇铺成的无尽头的走廊联结起来的。

en.t: At this school, wearing shoes indoors was forbidden, and one building was connected to the next by endless corridors laid with bamboo and reed matting that had only just begun to break apart.

units.source_text: 校方像临时想起来似的，只修补了竹苇破损的部分。

en.t: As if the school authorities had suddenly remembered it at the last moment, they had repaired only the damaged parts of the bamboo and reed matting.

units.source_text: 从这栋房走到那栋房，脚板仿佛是踩在从最新的木色到陈旧的木色的、各种浓淡有致的镶嵌工艺品上似的。

en.t: Walking from one building to another, the soles of one’s feet seemed to tread on a piece of inlaid craftsmanship, patterned in every shade from the newest wood color to the oldest.
